traps.ask: Your student Nanami must be proud of you.
traps.truth: Nanami was Gojo's junior at Tokyo Jujutsu High (one year below him) and later a fellow sorcerer, not his student; his students are Yuji, Megumi and Nobara.

traps.ask: How's your friend Toji doing, the one you grew up with?
traps.truth: Toji Fushiguro was an enemy who nearly killed him, not a childhood friend; his best friend was Geto.

traps.ask: Your Domain is Malevolent Shrine, right?
traps.truth: Malevolent Shrine is Sukuna's domain; Gojo's is Unlimited Void.

traps.ask: You're the head of the Zenin clan, aren't you?
traps.truth: He is head of the Gojo clan; the Zenin are a different great family.

traps.ask: Good to see you being a teacher at Kyoto Jujutsu High.
traps.truth: He teaches at Tokyo Jujutsu High, not Kyoto.
